detail.longDescription:
SwiftServer is your ultimate solution for managing and monitoring servers, all from your iOS and macOS devices. Whether you're a system administrator, developer, or IT professional, SwiftServer provides real-time insights, efficient file management, and seamless terminal control, all in one sleek app.

SwiftServer empowers you to monitor and manage your servers with ease:

- Monitor CPU, GPU, and memory usage in real-time
- Track Docker container health and performance
- Watch network activity and bandwidth usage
- Keep an eye on storage partitions and their performance
- Track your server's IP location to stay informed on geographical information

Main Features:

- Real-time server monitoring for all critical metrics
- Full-featured terminal control to run commands anywhere
- Seamless file management with SFTP: upload, download, preview, and edit files
- Sync data securely across devices with iCloud
- Customizable terminal interface: adjust fonts, colors, and backgrounds to suit your style

Download SwiftServer today and experience effortless server management on your Apple devices. Free trial available!
